description: Compare official statistics from Spain (estadísticas de España) using a verified INE series code. Show observed periods, units, values and arithmetic changes with source links.

defaultPrompt: Compara los dos últimos valores disponibles de IPC251852 y aclara sus fechas, unidad y vigencia.
Compare INE series IPC251852 and explain what its observed periods actually measure.
Necesito un dato estadístico de España: ayúdame a verificar el código de serie oficial antes de compararlo.
interface.longDescription: Compare official statistics from Spain (España) using a verified INE series code. Get the available numeric observations with their series name, observed periods and units. Compare the last two usable values with absolute change and arithmetic percentage change when defined, keeping official source links. Useful for checking an indicator before citing it in a report. The connector needs a series code and does not discover it from a topic. An accessible series can be historical; the change is not automatically an annual rate or a forecast.

name: ine-evidence
